name: Checkbox
summary: Labelled checkbox row (Radix Checkbox). The whole row is a native <label>.

parts.description: className applies to the outer label row.

props.name: error
props.description: Recolors the label text only (not the box).

passthrough.note: checked accepts boolean | "indeterminate"; also defaultChecked, onCheckedChange, required, disabled, name, value.

constraints.rule: Indeterminate state is checked="indeterminate"; there is no separate prop.
Do not wrap in your own <label> or add htmlFor; the row is already a label.
